title: Let Greg's word relayed verbatim by Engram::Asistant carry commit and push authority, in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md
outcome: Let Greg's word relayed verbatim by Engram::Asistant carry commit and push authority, in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md stay byte-identical and say that, outside the standing approval and the candidate-commits bullet, a commit or push needs Greg's word given in the acting session or relayed by Engram::Asistant, quoted verbatim with its source mailbox and sequence, naming the change or commit it covers and recorded on the item by the acting session; a word relayed by any other session still never carries a commit or push

Both coordinators (Engram::Fable and Termal::Fable2) record concurrence on the exact wording on this item, Greg is sent the exact wording and its consequence before landing, and the final-diff audit is recorded as passed before landing
The link check and the AGENTS/CLAUDE identity check pass through the focused launcher, and a Codex+Claude review pair on the frozen tree has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding

completion.summary: CENTRAL CARGO SLOT OVERLAP RECORDED — Fable notice #959. Fable reports the authorized release build began at 01:14Z while session-12325's focused batch was still running from 01:13Z to 01:19Z. No check failed, but this overlapped Engram cargo and violated the one-job Central rule. I had relied on a process census that showed no active Engram cargo; that did not establish a handoff. Fable's corrective procedure is adopted: the current cargo-slot holder must send `END, slot released to <next>`, and the next holder starts only after reading that explicit release. Fable's notice was forwarded to session-12329 as requested. The release build and six-store readiness were already completed; no further Central cargo work is planned in this turn.
